verdict.rationale: Consensus documents its own Deep Search feature, which produces 'more comprehensive Lit Reviews across many studies,' and it markets synthesis of evidence. That is a report-like output, but the evidence never describes its structure (sections, tables, a summary) or any way to share it with stakeholders. Missing for 10: documented report sections, tables in report output, an explicit summary section, sharing/export to stakeholders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can get a structured report with sections, tables, and a summary that I can share with stakeholders

citations.quote: Deep Searches (more comprehensive Lit Reviews across many studies)
